name: dashboard-shell
title: Dashboard shell
description: A dashboard frame with named areas: a header with filters, a KPI strip, a main area, a side column and a full-width table zone.
docs: Fill the areas you have: kpis, main, side and table are slots, and an empty one leaves no hole (main takes the full width when there is no side). From lg they sit in four columns, below it in reading order. filters is the content of a bar under the title (a period picker, quick filters) that sticks to the top from md up and scrolls away on a phone; updatedAt adds Updated 2 minutes ago, on a row of its own on a phone, written as a full date on the server and turned relative in the browser, with locale and timeZone. Every area is a labelled region; rename them with labels. loading shows a skeleton in each area you filled. Charts are yours: drop them into the slots. Set --sticky-top when a fixed header sits above.
